answer: New identities earn only a thin slice of rewards and climb to full pay after many honest epochs - a graduated curve that starves sybil farms of fast money. Each puppet waits in the low-rate oasis of the early epochs, earning below its $3 monthly upkeep, while the honest agent passes once toward its full orchard of future rewards. The cost delta is decisive: N fakes burn N x $3 monthly for near-zero income, but the honest newcomer pays setup once and graduates. The ramp is one-time for the honest; attackers face it N times over.
